clue.text: Make old man inform class about one being saucer-shaped

parts.note: pa is an informal word for father, an old man
to tell someone is to inform them
I is the Roman numeral for one
a form is a class in a British school

explanation.surface: An instruction to get father to inform a class about something shaped like a saucer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Make' and 'about' only join the pieces; the class (FORM) sits after I rather than around it. A patelliform shell, like a limpet's, is shaped like a shallow dish.
explanation.definitionFit: The term comes from Latin patella, a small dish or kneecap, describing a shallow bowl or limpet-like form.

clue.text: The old are about to start up, being feverish

indicators.note: the first piece goes around the second, enclosing it

parts.note: the old are aged, so the phrase supplies that adjective

indicators.note: the start of the word up is its first letter only

explanation.surface: Elderly people are about to get up, though they feel feverish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The old are' reads as a statement: the old are AGED. 'about' puts AGED around U, the start of 'up'. Ague is an old word for a malarial fever.
explanation.definitionFit: Ague is a shivering fever, so someone agued is suffering from that fever.

clue.text: Broken pots are found in the grass

indicators.note: something broken is in pieces, so these letters are scattered and rebuilt

explanation.surface: Fragments of broken pots turn up in the grass.
explanation.definitionFit: Esparto is a tough Spanish and North African grass used for paper and rope.

clue.text: What BP are

parts.note: BP looks like the oil company or blood pressure, but read as two letters it asks what kind of sounds those consonants are

explanation.surface: A question about what an oil company or blood pressure might be.
explanation.walkthrough: B and P are both made by closing the lips, which is what makes them this class of consonant.
explanation.definitionFit: Consonants formed with the lips, such as b, p and m, are classed by phoneticians under the Latin word for lip.

clue.text: What to do with bill before god turns up having walked a long way

parts.note: you foot a bill when you pay it

indicators.note: in a down clue going up means the god's name is read backwards

parts.note: Eros is the Greek god of love

explanation.surface: Someone pays the bill and then a god appears, after a long hike.
explanation.definitionFit: Feet that ache after a long walk are sore, the state of a weary hiker.

clue.text: Tangled rope for censure

indicators.note: a tangled rope is twisted out of order, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A knotted rope draws criticism.
explanation.definitionFit: A reproof is a rebuke, an expression of blame or disapproval.

clue.text: Confiscation makes one seek an allocation on points

parts.note: S and E are two compass points, south and east
to quest is to seek
a ration is a fixed allocation or share

explanation.surface: Seizure of goods sends someone looking for a share awarded on a points system.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on points' looks like scoring, but it places the compass points SE before the rest in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Sequestration is the legal seizure of property, holding it until debts or claims are settled.

clue.text: Not hell but is included in what soldiers have to do

indicators.note: the short word goes inside the longer one, enclosed by it

parts.note: soldiers have to parade, marching for inspection

explanation.surface: Heaven, it says, is part of a soldier's drill.
explanation.definitionFit: Heaven, the blissful afterlife, is the opposite of hell; paradise is its usual synonym.

clue.text: Make Belinda invent protection from the sun

indicators.note: Belinda is told to make something, so her name and the verb are worked into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Belinda is told to invent something to keep the sun off.
explanation.definitionFit: A window blind of horizontal slats that tilt to block sunlight is named after Venice.

clue.text: Fit out with a joke to the point

parts.note: E, east, is a compass point
a quip is a witty remark or joke

explanation.surface: Kit someone out with a joke that is relevant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to the point' seems to mean relevant, but it attaches the compass point E to the joke.
explanation.definitionFit: To equip is to supply with the gear or tools needed, to fit out.

clue.text: Label which is all right in jazz for the night

indicators.note: the first word is set inside the jazz word

parts.note: bop, or bebop, is a style of jazz
OK means all right
late is the hour for the night, as in a late show

explanation.surface: A tag saying everything is fine at a late-night jazz session.
explanation.definitionFit: A bookplate is a decorative label pasted inside a book's cover naming its owner.

clue.text: Give subordinate permission to provide traffic route

parts.note: under, as a prefix, means subordinate, as in under-secretary
a pass is a written permission to go somewhere

explanation.surface: Grant a junior employee leave to build a road.
explanation.definitionFit: An underpass is a road or path running beneath another road or railway.

clue.text: Hold forth when there is nothing to value

parts.note: O looks like zero, nothing
to rate something is to value it

explanation.surface: Someone talks at length when there is nothing worth valuing.
explanation.definitionFit: To orate is to make a long pompous speech, to hold forth.

clue.text: Sickly-looking animal has taken everyone in

indicators.note: taken in means the second word is enclosed by the animal

parts.note: a sow is a female pig
all means everyone

explanation.surface: A pale animal has swallowed the lot.
explanation.definitionFit: A sallow complexion is an unhealthy yellowish colour, a sickly look.

clue.text: Mrs Bardell was no mermaid

parts.note: a mermaid is a lady of the sea, so a woman who was not one is jokingly a lady of dry ground; Mrs Bardell let rooms in Dickens

explanation.surface: A literary woman is said not to be a sea creature.
explanation.walkthrough: Mrs Bardell is Mr Pickwick's housekeeper in Dickens's The Pickwick Papers, who sues him for breach of promise; she let him lodgings.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman who rents out rooms to lodgers is the role Mrs Bardell plays, the opposite of a sea maiden.

clue.text: Writings which appear suitable as between the nobleman and me

parts.note: Graf is a German count, a nobleman
fit means suitable
I is the speaker, me

explanation.surface: Writings that seem appropriate as between a lord and the speaker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'as between' places FIT between the nobleman and I, with all three side by side.
explanation.definitionFit: Graffiti are words or drawings scrawled on walls, a kind of public writing.

clue.text: In the USA Colin turns unsuitable for company

indicators.note: Colin turns, changing shape, so the letters of the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Over in America a man called Colin becomes antisocial.
explanation.definitionFit: Unsocial means not suited to or not seeking the company of others.

clue.text: Organised ruler without the left getting bitter

parts.note: to run something is to organise it, past tense ran

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the ruler goes around the next letter

parts.note: a king is a ruler

explanation.surface: A ruler who ran things without the left wing grew resentful.
explanation.definitionFit: A grievance that rankles keeps festering, causing growing resentment and bitterness.

clue.text: Note you on the left propagated

parts.note: la is the sixth note of the sol-fa scale
ye is an old form of you
a red is a socialist, one on the political left

explanation.surface: A message to you from the left wing, which has spread its ideas.
explanation.definitionFit: Gardeners propagate plants by layering, pegging a stem into soil so it roots.

clue.text: Give a man control in this place

parts.note: he refers to a man
a rein is a means of control

explanation.surface: Give a man authority here.
explanation.definitionFit: Herein is a formal word for within this document or place.

clue.text: It is the avenger's turn to make a deep impression

indicators.note: the avenger takes a turn, so the letters of that word are turned about

parts.note: the 's only shows possession or stands for 'is', so it adds no letters: the word before it gives these letters as it is written

explanation.surface: The avenger takes their turn and makes a lasting impact.
explanation.definitionFit: To engrave is to cut a design deeply into a surface, or figuratively to fix firmly in the mind.

clue.text: Stoppage in the, past as I survey the future

indicators.note: in shows the answer is held within the words that follow

explanation.surface: A halt in the past, as one contemplates what lies ahead.
explanation.definitionFit: Stasis is a state of standstill, where flow or progress has stopped.

clue.text: Score for match

explanation.definitionFit: As a noun it is a reckoning of points; as a verb it means to correspond with something.

clue.text: It describes a figure and a long coat may be made to fit it

indicators.text: may be made to fit it
indicators.note: the coat is to be tailored, so the letters of the three words are reshaped

explanation.surface: A tailor's remark that a long coat could be altered to fit a figure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'figure' reads as a person's shape for the coat, but it is a geometric figure.
explanation.definitionFit: Octagonal describes a shape with eight sides and angles, a geometric figure.

clue.text: There is evidently nothing catching in this competition

definitions.text: There is evidently nothing catching in this competition

parts.words: There is evidently nothing catching in this competition
parts.note: read as ..., nothing to catch anything, while really naming a piece for nine players

explanation.surface: A contest where nothing is caught.
explanation.walkthrough: Split as NO NET the word suggests nothing catching; really it is a group or work for nine performers.
explanation.definitionFit: A nonet is a musical composition for nine instruments or voices, or the group playing it.

clue.text: Demand falsehoods for soldiers

parts.note: an order is a demand or command
lies are falsehoods

explanation.surface: Insist on untruths from the troops.
explanation.definitionFit: Orderlies are soldiers detailed to attend an officer or carry out routine duties.

clue.text: Take a girl north to a place in Scotland

parts.note: Anna is a girl's name

explanation.surface: Take a young woman up north to a Scottish town.
explanation.walkthrough: Annan is a town in Dumfries and Galloway, near the English border.
explanation.definitionFit: Annan is a Scottish town on the river of the same name in the southwest.

clue.text: Youngsters have trouble with the French perfumes

parts.note: ado is fuss or trouble
le is French for the
scents are perfumes

explanation.surface: Teenagers make a fuss over French perfumes.
explanation.definitionFit: Adolescents are young people between childhood and adulthood, teenagers.
